title: Coconut Natilla Recipe
hookLine: Global-inspired coconut natilla recipe with 12 measured ingredients — zero sign-up, instant Cook Mode.

steps.title: Simmer & Dissolve Smoothly
steps.instructionTemplate: Place 1 cup of milk in a small bowl, add the cornstarch and stir to dissolve it, then set aside. Stir gently over low to medium-low heat until completely dissolved and glossy, scraping the sides so nothing crystallizes or scorches. Incorporate {m53524_1}, {m53524_2}, {m53524_3}, and {m53524_4} smoothly until evenly distributed.
steps.creatorSecret: Prep and measure milk first—mise en place makes this dessert twice as fast.

steps.title: Dip & Coat Evenly
steps.instructionTemplate: Place the coconut milk and grated coconut in the blender and blend until smooth and set aside. Whisk steadily around the bottom and corners of the pan until glossy, thickened, and smooth enough to coat the back of a spoon. Incorporate {m53524_5}, {m53524_6}, {m53524_7}, {m53524_8}, {m53524_9}, {m53524_10}, {m53524_11}, and {m53524_12} smoothly until evenly distributed.

steps.title: Simmer & Dissolve Smoothly
steps.instructionTemplate: Place the rest of the milk and cinnamon sticks in a medium pot and bring the mixture to boil over medium-low heat. When the milk is a little warm, but not boiling, add the coconut mixture.

steps.title: Bake Until Golden & Set
steps.instructionTemplate: When the milk starts boiling, add the condensed milk, sugar and salt. Stir well with a wooden spoon. Add the milk and cornstarch mixture and continue stirring constantly.

steps.title: Cool, Garnish & Serve
steps.instructionTemplate: Add the vanilla extract. Reduce the heat to low and continue stirring until the Natilla thickens, about 10 to 20 minutes. Add the butter, stir and remove from the heat. Discard the cinnamon sticks. Ladle into a serving dish or individual custard cups. Sprinkle cinnamon powder on top and let it cool at room temperature for at least 2 hours. Refrigerate until ready to serve.
steps.criticalTip: Let set for 5–10 minutes before slicing or plating so the textures hold crisp and photogenic!
steps.creatorSecret: Measure aromatics and syrups before heating so timing stays crisp and your glaze hits glossy perfection.
